outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry pseudocolor/density plots (gating strategy) where each dot represents an individual cell event; no averaged/summary statistic is being depicted, so individual data points are inherently present.
Panel B shows flow cytometry dot plots for PC gating; individual cell events are displayed directly, not an average.
Panel C is a flow cytometry gating strategy (scatter/density plots) showing individual cell events rather than an aggregated statistic.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay scatter plot of individual cells from three populations (MBC, GC, naive); each point is an individual data point, not an average.
Panel E shows flow cytometry gating plots of MBC subsets with individual cell events plotted directly; no summary average is shown.
